GRADE 6 SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY — TERM 1 EXAM

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Time: 30 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Invertebrates in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify common invertebrates in the environment,
   B. Learners should ignore Invertebrates completely.
   C. Invertebrates is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Invertebrates.

2. About Invertebrates around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. practise precautions in handling invertebrates,
   B. Learners should ignore Invertebrates completely.
   C. Invertebrates is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Invertebrates.

3. About Invertebrates in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the general characteristics of invertebrates,
   B. Learners should ignore Invertebrates completely.
   C. Invertebrates is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Invertebrates.

5. About Change of State in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the changes of state when substances are heated or cooled,
   B. Learners should ignore Change of State completely.
   C. Change of State is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Change of State.

6. About Change of State around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the applications of the change of state of matter in everyday life,
   B. Learners should ignore Change of State completely.
   C. Change of State is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Change of State.

7. About Change of State in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the changes of state when substances are heated or cooled,
   B. Learners should ignore Change of State completely.
   C. Change of State is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Change of State.

9. Which habit helps you revise SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

10. Which habit helps you revise SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

11. Which habit helps you revise SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

12. Which habit helps you revise SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Invertebrates in your school compound.
